CustomField.description: M score based on monetary percentile. 5 is top percentile band and 1 is lowest.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Lifetime_Paid_Amount__c), Lifetime_Paid_Amount__c <= 0 ), 0, IF( ISBLANK(Monetary_Percentile__c), NULL, IF( Monetary_Percentile__c >= 80, 5, IF( Monetary_Percentile__c >= 60, 4, IF( Monetary_Percentile__c >= 40, 3, IF(Monetary_Percentile__c >= 20, 2, 1) ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Monetary Score
